pages.text: $(#00CED1)🌊 Ocean Breeze Concerto · Tidal Speed Surge 🌱$()$(br2)$(l)$(#3CB371)「Let mint’s coolness become the fin of a dolphin, each sip a dance upon the waves」$()$(br)When the chill of $(#3CB371)frosted mint$(), the purity of $(#00BFFF)millennia-old ice core$(), the sweetness of $(#DAA520)sunlight sugar crystals$(), and the vitality of $(#FF6B6B)coral powder$() collide within the $(#4682B4)Tidal Shaker$()—a swift elixir is born, one that makes $(l)the body resonate with the rhythm of ocean currents$().

$(#00BFFF)▌ Dolphin’s Swiftness $()$(br2)$(l)$(#32CD32)🌪 Rapid Flow Acceleration$()$(br)While moving, leave behind a $(#7FFFD4)bubble trail$() like a $(#00CED1)sailfish$() slicing through the waves.$(br2)$(l)$(#FF6B6B)🐚 Coral Empowerment$()$(br)Each step imprints $(#FF4500)glowing coral patterns$() on the ground, boosting movement.

$(br2)$(#3CB371)▌ Wave Surge Brewing $()$(br)- Use a $(#4682B4)coral mortar$() to grind $(#3CB371)mint$() into $(#7FFFD4)icy mist$().$(br)- Sculpt $(#00BFFF)ice blocks$() into $(#87CEEB)miniature whirlpools$().$(br)- Shake the mixture in the $(#4682B4)Tidal Shaker$() at a $(#FF6B6B)rate of three shakes per second$().$(br2)$(#7FFFD4)※$() A perfect brew forms $(#00CED1)layered bubble columns$() with a $(#3CB371)jade-green halo$().

$(br2)$(#4682B4)『 The Mermaid’s Song 』$()$(br)Shell carvings from the Tidal Cave:$(br)'Those who drink this $(#00CED1)liquid ocean breeze$()$(br)shall gain the swiftness of $(#3CB371)dolphins$() and the explosive force of $(#FF6B6B)coral$()—$(br)By the time the sweetness of $(#DAA520)sugar crystals$() lingers on your tongue,$(br)your $(#32CD32)silhouette$() has already pierced through the $(#00BFFF)waves$() like an $(#4682B4)arrow$() unleashed.'
